name: Zero-inflated negative-binomial scaling (experimental)
description: Fits a proper ZINB mixture per sample over the full empirical catalogue; the zero term includes the (1-pi) factor.
may_suit: Sensitivity analysis when a ZINB distribution and fitted NB-component mean are defensible scale references.
caution: Catalogue-dependent zeros are not biological structural zeros. Fit convergence does not validate the model; no automatic preference or subsequent CPM.
